title: 串并联混合网络
summary: 先把网络一步步化简，算出两个结点的电压，再搭出来用万用表核对。
description: 电路：R1（1 kΩ）从 +9 V 接到结点 M；从 M 到 GND 有两条并联支路：支路甲是 R2（2 kΩ）；支路乙是 R3（1 kΩ）和 R4（1 kΩ）串联，中间的结点叫 X。先化简算出 M、X 的电压，再搭出来测量。

cards.title: 先算，再搭
text: 这一题没有步骤。动手之前，先在纸上把网络**从最远处往回化简**，预测 M 和 X 的电压。

cards.title: 一层一层化简
text: 1. 支路乙是串联：$R_3 + R_4 = 2$ kΩ。
2. 支路甲和支路乙并联：$2\ \text{k} \parallel 2\ \text{k} = 1$ kΩ（两个一样的电阻并联，等于一半）。
3. 这 1 kΩ 再和 R1 串联，就是一个分压器：M 点 = 9 V × 1 / (1 + 1)。
4. X 在 R3、R4 中间，又是一个分压器：X = M × 1 / (1 + 1)。
![](fig:network)
并联公式：$R_a \parallel R_b = \frac{R_a R_b}{R_a + R_b}$。

cards.title: 搭好，量两个结点
text: - 先给每个结点分一条金属条：M、X 各一列，再加一列接 GND。
- R2 和（R3 + R4）的两端分别都在 M 和 GND 上。

cards.title: 带走
text: - 化简口诀：**从离电源最远的地方开始，串联就加，并联就“积除以和”**，一层一层往回收。
- 化简只是为了算总电流或某个结点电压；算完要**回到原电路**去求支路里的电流和电压。

caption.text: 支路乙（R3 + R4）先串成 2 kΩ，再和支路甲（R2）并联成 1 kΩ，最后和 R1 组成一个分压器。

i18n.en: Branch B (R3 + R4) makes 2 kΩ in series, in parallel with branch A (R2) that is 1 kΩ, and with R1 it forms a divider.

en.title: A series-parallel network
en.summary: Simplify the network step by step, work out two node voltages, then build it and check with the multimeter.
en.description: Circuit: R1 (1 kΩ) from +9 V to node M; from M to GND two parallel branches: branch A is R2 (2 kΩ); branch B is R3 (1 kΩ) in series with R4 (1 kΩ), the node between them called X. Simplify to predict the voltages at M and X, then build and measure.
hints: Give each node a strip: one column each for M and X, plus one going to GND.
R2 and (R3 + R4) both have their ends on M and GND.
tests: Sensible voltages at nodes M and X

cards.title: Work it out, then build it
text: No steps here. Before you build, simplify the network on paper **from the far end back towards the source** and predict the voltages at M and X.

cards.title: Simplify layer by layer
text: 1. Branch B is in series: $R_3 + R_4 = 2$ kΩ.
2. Branches A and B in parallel: $2\ \text{k} \parallel 2\ \text{k} = 1$ kΩ (two equal resistors in parallel give half).
3. That 1 kΩ in series with R1 is a divider: M = 9 V × 1 / (1 + 1).
4. X sits between R3 and R4 — another divider: X = M × 1 / (1 + 1).
![](fig:network)
Parallel formula: $R_a \parallel R_b = \frac{R_a R_b}{R_a + R_b}$.

cards.title: Build it, measure two nodes
text: - Give each node a strip first: one column each for M and X, plus one to GND.
- R2 and (R3 + R4) both connect between M and GND.

cards.title: Take away
text: - The recipe: **start furthest from the source; in series add, in parallel "product over sum"**, and fold it back layer by layer.
- Simplifying only gives you the total current or a node voltage; to find a branch current or voltage, **go back to the original circuit**.

measurements.ask: Multimeter: node M relative to GND
measurements.explain: R2 ∥ (R3 + R4) = 1 kΩ, a divider with R1: 9 × 1 / 2 = 4.5 V.

measurements.ask: Multimeter: node X relative to GND
measurements.explain: R3 and R4 are equal, so X sits at half of M: 4.5 / 2 = 2.25 V.

tests.name: M、X 两个结点的电压合理

measurements.ask: 万用表：结点 M 对 GND 的电压
万用表：结点 X 对 GND 的电压
measurements.explain: R3、R4 一样大，X 正好在 M 的一半：4.5 / 2 = 2.25 V。
